description: This file defines an Evented class with methods for event handling, including adding/removing listeners, firing events, and event propagation, used in the Leaflet mapping library.

classes.name: Evented
classes.description: A class that provides event handling capabilities, including methods for managing event listeners and propagation.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Adds event listeners for specified event types, supporting multiple types and event maps.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Removes event listeners, supports removing all, specific types, or specific functions with optional context.

methods.name: _on
methods.description: Internal method to attach a single event listener for a specific type and context.

methods.name: _off
methods.description: Internal method to detach a specific event listener for a type and context.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Fires an event of a given type, passing data and optionally propagating to parent event handlers.

methods.name: listens
methods.description: Checks if there are listeners for a specific event type, optionally propagating check to parent event handlers.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Adds a one-time event listener that is removed after being fired.

methods.name: addEventParent
methods.description: Adds a parent object to propagate events to.

methods.name: removeEventParent
methods.description: Removes a parent object from event propagation.

methods.name: _propagateEvent
methods.description: Internal method to propagate events to parent event handlers.
